PAKISTAN LEGAL PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS
(AMENDMENT) RULES, 1990
(Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 21st February, 1990)
S.R.O.178(I)/90, dated 15‑2‑1990.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 of the Legal Practitioners and
Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), and other enabling provisions in that
behalf, the Pakistan Bar Council hereby makes and notifies the following
amendments in the Pakistan Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Rules, 1976,.
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(a)
These Rules may be called the Pakistan Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils
(Amendment) Rules, 1990.
(b) They shall come into force
at one
2. Amendment of Rule 3 of the
Pakistan Legal Practitioners and Bar
Councils Rules, 1976: ‑(a) after the word "province" at the
end of clause (i) of sub‑rule (i) of Rule 3 the following words be added:
"or in his absence the
Additional Advocate‑General in order of seniority, and where there is no
Additional Advocate‑General, an Assistant Advocate -General in order of
seniority." .
(b) after the word
"Pakistan" at the end of clause (ii) of sub‑rule (i) of Rule 3
the following words be added:
or in his absence a Deputy
Attorney General in order of seniority.'
